purpose: Determine whether Apple raster setup depends only on the numerical plane numerator and determinant, or on the factorization that produced them. Each odd-height case is paired with power-of-two controls having the exact same determinant. A sealed 4096-input bank also makes the mathematical plane numerator exactly equal in the odd and power cases.

changedVariables: replace the 8192-wide normalized-denominator sweep by 64 stratified exact-normalized odd determinant cases
add two power-of-two factorizations of every determinant
replace 14 coefficient witnesses by 4096 low-byte phase samples and 4096 unseen exact-product samples
unchangedVariables: Apple Metal rasterizer and fast-math compilation
256-pixel power-of-two vertical target and viewport transform
the established divide-by-four boundary delta and divide-by-two remaining deltas

baseCases.selection: sixteen inclusive quantiles from every sorted exact-normalized width set
baseCases.normalizedWidthFormula: determinant >> areaShift with zero discarded bits

inputs.fineGenerator: 16 banks by all 256 low-byte phases from the established full-mantissa product corpus

capture.oddDelta: input significand at binary32 exponent 126, then divided by four at odd width 8192 or by two otherwise
capture.powerFloorDelta: floor binary32(scaledOddInputDelta * oddHeight / powerHeight) generated by exact integer arithmetic
capture.powerCeilDelta: ceil binary32(scaledOddInputDelta * oddHeight / powerHeight) generated by exact integer arithmetic

slopeRecovery.constantSharing: one recovered constant shared by x zero, x 15, and x 31

prospectiveControl.hypothesis: If setup depends only on numerical numerator and determinant, every odd, power-floor, and power-ceil recovered slope in the exact bank is bit-identical.
prospectiveControl.interpretationOnPass: The unexplained behavior is not edge factorization; subsequent tomography must target the fused numerical numerator/reciprocal arithmetic.
prospectiveControl.interpretationOnFailure: Apple setup is factorization-dependent; the mismatch signatures directly identify which height, determinant, and input bits expose that path.

crossRunControl.purpose: Verify that the retained target, viewport, geometry, scaled deltas, and top-left primitive reproduce the exact Apple slopes frozen from run 30663719233 before interpreting new factorization comparisons.

nonClaims: This is a discovery capture except for the sealed exact-factorization comparison.
Neither outcome establishes a complete odd-height arithmetic law.
This probe does not establish non-exact determinant selection, clip-generated setup, or end-to-end Liquid Glass parity.
